## Support metadata

```js
import support from "@viewstem/ui/support.json" with { type: "json" };

const button = support.find(component => component.id === "shadcn.Button");
console.log(button.ports, button.slots, button.events);
```

Use `ports` for input schemas, `slots` for named slots, and `events` for event payload schemas. See the [mount guide](../guides/mount-in-browser/) and [registration API](../api/).
